extra: Main line carries the F1 follow-up fixes (4.22.0, CHANGES-V3.md section F1) – keep them. Final VERSION 4.23.0. Rule from Xander 27.10.: do NOTHING beyond what is listed here or in the spec (typische-fehler.md Nr. 27). ALSO: (1) rename the library collection from 'Kompakt' to 'Micro' everywhere (Xander 27.10.); (2) remove the outdated wording 'Platzhalter' / 'die Originalwellen folgen später aus Aufnahmen' for the 64 stored waves (Xander decided 25.10. that the 64 waves traced from the oscilloscope PDF ARE the built-in waves): label them 'nachgezeichnet', keep ≈ only for the doubtful wave 60; run node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deutsch-Mit-Xander/9f6e2ea9-5438-5564-bb39-64bc754f0143/scratchpad/dirigent-test/v3-mk2-wellen.mjs <app> (must stay all PASS); (3) REVERT two self-invented behaviours Xander never asked for (see G-MKP8-merge-fix in CHANGES-MK.md): the automatic mic restart when the page returns from the background (back to: mic stays off, the existing hint), and the 150 ms delay of '▶ Hören' in the ⋯ menu (back to: plays immediately; keep finger-scrolling of the menu); (4) F1 left the marker editor raster buttons at 34 px and some landscape header buttons at 38 px: every touch target must be at least 44 × 44 px (typische-fehler Nr. 4) – enlarge the hit areas, invisibly where possible as in (e), otherwise two rows or a scrollable row, without changing what the controls do. (5) The MK8b branch test (4 findings, all left unfixed in the branch) – fix them in the merged app: (a) rule 27: the genre tabs must carry exactly the spec names TRANCE · TECHNO/HOUSE · ELECTRONICA · D&B/BREAKS · HIPHOP/VINTAGE · RETRO · S.E./HIT · VOCODER in every format (no shortened TECHNO/ELECTRO/D&B/HIPHOP; the chip row may scroll sideways); (b) rule 27: remove the self-added permanent hint row ('.mkkvoc') in the VOCODER tab – only the Claude-window vocoder hint as in 4.17.0 stays (spec MK8b Umfang 4); (c) typical defect A1: at 320×568 the row sub-labels (program number + role) of the library rows must not be cut off with an ellipsis (repro: node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deutsch-Mit-Xander/9f6e2ea9-5438-5564-bb39-64bc754f0143/scratchpad/dirigent-test/v3-qa-mk8b-p3count.mjs <app>); (d) vocoder loudness: with a natural voice spectrum all 16 vocoder programs must lie within −18 ± 3 LUFS like every other program (Metal Voc and Whisper Voc are 5–12 dB too quiet; calibrate against a natural vowel, not the bright pre-emphasised dummy; repro scripts /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deutsch-Mit-Xander/9f6e2ea9-5438-5564-bb39-64bc754f0143/scratchpad/dirigent-test/v3-qa-mk8b-vocpegel.mjs, v3-qa-mk8b-vowelwav.mjs, v3-qa-mk8b-live.mjs); (e) the chip 'Micro' and the 8 genre tabs must have a hit area of at least 44 × 44 px – enlarge the HIT AREA invisibly (e.g. a transparent ::before/::after or padding with negative margin), keeping the visible chip height Xander knows; if that is impossible without a visible change, do not build it and list it under 'Fragen an Xander' in the changelog; (f) MK8-08: loading a vocoder program must stay ≤ 50 ms without a long task – start the microphone right after the load (not synchronously inside it); behaviour otherwise unchanged. Name the new genre/collection exactly 'Micro' (not 'Kompakt', not 'microKORG'); no Korg/microKORG/RADIAS/DWGS word anywhere in the app.
testNote: Acceptance items of THIS merge (each failure is severity 'major', not 'minor'): collection named 'Micro' everywhere (no 'Kompakt'); spec genre names unshortened; no permanent VOCODER hint row; no 'Platzhalter'/'Originalwellen folgen' wording, waves labelled 'nachgezeichnet', ≈ only for wave 60, node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deutsch-Mit-Xander/9f6e2ea9-5438-5564-bb39-64bc754f0143/scratchpad/dirigent-test/v3-mk2-wellen.mjs <app> all PASS; mic does NOT restart automatically on return from background; '▶ Hören' in the ⋯ menu plays immediately; every touch target (incl. library chips, marker raster buttons, landscape header buttons) has a hit area ≥ 44 × 44 px; 320×568 library row sub-labels not cut; vocoder programs −18 ± 3 LUFS with a natural vowel; vocoder program load ≤ 50 ms without long task; VERSION 4.23.0; and rule 27 (typische-fehler.md Nr. 27): anything built that is not in the spec, the error list or this list is a 'major' defect.
